SRC-048:R001.text: Repair AUDAPACK's OpenCode launch boundary so SAIPEN-managed projects are launched through the canonical SAIPEN host launcher with bound actor, root, and lineage; preserve ordinary non-SAIPEN project direct launch; route compatible custom templates through SAIPEN and refuse unbound; preserve instance monitor attribution, focus reuse, and multi-instance Shift+click; ensure clean interactive TTY without stderr redirection; disable OpenCode dynamic title updates via OPENCODE_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE=true; ensure durable managed console title and asynchronous non-blocking startup observation; verify on real Windows.
